channel.description: Level up your Java code and explore what Spring can do for you.

item.title: This Week in Spring - August 4th, 2026
item.dc:creator: joshlong
item.content:encoded:
Hi, Spring fans! Welcome to another installment of This Week in Spring! It's the 4th of August! We're already in month eight of this year! Great Scott!

  • This is an interesting project to help ensure idempotency keys for Spring Boot requests
  • A very interesting post on The New Stack titled, When vendor-supplied support matters: [How AI is changing the open source security equation], which features commentary from our very own Ryan Morgan](https://thenewstack.io/ai-open-source-security/)
  • Have you heard about agentic loops? Check out this nice explainer on what it is and why it matters
  • I loved this explainer on RabbitMQ Streams! by Gregory Green
  • I really liked this talk by Neo4j founder Emil Eifrem on AI ontologies
  • I was very happy to be interviewed on the Marco Behler JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA team a few weeks ago
  • Last week I was thrilled to sit down and chat with Spring Boot cofounder Phil Webb about the latest and greatest!
  • I like this post looking at dynamic configuration with Spring Cloud
  • Wow! Look at this! A whole workshop-style thing looking at microservices with Spring Cloud
  • Wanna integrate DynamoDB into your Spring Boot application? Baeldung's got a nice post

item.title: A Bootiful Podcast: Spring Boot founder and lead Phil Webb
item.dc:creator: joshlong
item.content:encoded: Hi, Spring fans! In this installment I talk to Spring Boot cofounder Phil Webb who joins the show to unpack the latest Spring Boot 4.1 release, from the long-awaited Spring gRPC support and MongoDB batch starter to security, observability, service connections, and other polished improvements.

item.title: This Week in Spring - July 28th, 2026
item.dc:creator: joshlong
item.content:encoded:
Hi Spring fans! Welcome to another installment of This Week in Spring! The title says in Spring, but here in the northern hemisphere, it's clearly the middle of summer. Hot! I'm sitting here on my laptop on a warm summer day, and my laptop is indeed hot because I've spent so much time outside learning about the latest and greatest in the wild and wonderful Spring ecosystem. Let's dive into it before the laptop gets hotter than a Scala compilation!

  • Neat! Check out the even more intelligent experience for people using the Spring Tools (such as with Visual Studio Code or Eclipse): a new Spring Tools MCP server!
  • Hey everybody! I'll be doing a webinar for JetBrains on what's new in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA to support Spring developers
  • Speaking of JetBrains, I was on the JetBrains channel doing an interview on the Marco Show
  • This is super cool to see talked about: did you know Tanzu, where most of the Spring team resides, also ships SLSA Level 3-compliant dependencies? Read this amazing post from Tanzu general manager Purnima Padmanabhan for more!
  • An oldie but a goodie, unearthed from a recent discussion on dynamic multi-tenancy with Spring Boot
  • Another amazing post from Craig Walls on visualizing Spring AI Alibaba workflow graphs
  • I love this latest post from our friend Craig Walls looking at how to persist Spring AI with ChatMemory and JDBC
  • Another amazing post from Craig Walls, this one on three new ways to persist ChatMemory with Spring AI
  • In last week's installment of A Bootiful Podcast, I had the privilege of talking to Java Developer Advocate Billy Korando about the latest and greatest in the forthcoming Java 27
  • I did a video looking at the latest and greatest in Spring Batch in Spring Boot 4.1. Namely, I looked at the support for using MongoDB-backed repositories with Spring Batch
  • I liked this latest installment of Spring Boot full course fundamentals, this one looking at how to use Hibernate
  • I loved this new project from my friend Brian Sam-Boden proposing a new in-memory vector search engine that has an easy out-of-the-box integration for Spring AI

item.title: Spring Office Hours Podcast: S5E19 - Docker, Compose, Testcontainers, Oh My!
item.dc:creator: danvega
item.content:encoded:

In this episode, Dan and DaShaun will discuss some of the new features around Docker, Testcontainers and the Spring Boot plugin. You can participate in our live stream to ask questions or catch the replay on your preferred podcast platform.
